headline: First reading of an overnight field trip to Greece in April 2028, plus a FY26 fund balance update and an enrollment update.
summary: The agenda includes a first reading of a 2028 world language trip to Greece and a second reading of a 7th grade overnight trip to Ecology School. It also covers enrollment and fund balance updates, a food service presentation, and personnel items.
items: Food service presentation by Caroline Trinder, Nutrition Director
Consent agenda: nomination of Jennifer Campbell, BHS Special Education Teacher
Consent agenda: appointment of Tom Klicsak, Transportation Van Driver
Consent agenda: resignation of Richard Dutremble, District Director of Technology, retirement
Consent agenda: resignation of Patricia Hoyt, BMS FLS Ed Tech I
Consent agenda: resignation of Jessica Cinquegrano, BHS Nutrition
Consent agenda: resignation of Helen Hartnett, BPS Nutrition

Committee reports: Advisory Committee on Policy (summary of August 12 meeting), Advisory Committee on Curriculum & Instruction, Finance/Building & Grounds Committee, Negotiations/Personnel, Evaluation Committee, Southern Maine Administrative Collaborative
New business: Fund Balance Update FY26
New business: Books, Talks & Tools, professional learning for everyone
Second reading of overnight field trip for BMS 7th Grade to Ecology School
First reading of overnight field trip: World Language Trip to Greece, April Vacation 2028, teachers in charge Cassily and McGovern
